ops.repl: HybridCache is the in-box default for read-through with stampede protection; FusionCache adds fail-safe, eager refresh and a backplane; use IDistributedCache directly where you need full control.

ops.find: Decision rules to leave audience with. FusionCache + IDistributedCache is the default modern stack: read-through with stampede protection via GetOrSetAsync, write-through via SetAsync, eager-refresh built in. Drop to IDistributedCache directly when you want full control. Write-around for telemetry. Write-back is the niche extreme-throughput pattern. The bold final line is the take-home: don't pick one pattern as 'the' cache strategy. FusionCache for 95% of cases is the modern default; everything else is a specialization.
ops.repl: Decision rules. HybridCache over the Redis IDistributedCache is the in-box stack: read-through with stampede protection via GetOrCreateAsync, write-through via SetAsync. FusionCache is the alternative when you need fail-safe stale fallback, eager refresh or a backplane for multi-Pod L1 invalidation. Drop to IDistributedCache directly when you want full control. Write-around for telemetry. Write-back is the niche extreme-throughput pattern. The bold final line is the take-home: don't pick one pattern as 'the' cache strategy; choose per read path.
